prompt_protocol: same five NExT-GQA choices; correct A-E logprob minus best foil
estimand: mean[(full margin-evidence replaced margin) - (full margin-placebo replaced margin)]
interpretation: Positive means evidence-position frame replacement reduced the correct-vs-best-foil margin more than matched placebo replacement.
limitations: Exploratory outcome added after inspecting the free-answer probe.
Single-frame input replacement is a hybrid/OOD perturbation, not a direct causal test of explanation validity.
Choice-letter margin depends on this prompt and does not equal official free-generation accuracy.
